svg.title: POISONKEY: credentials that punish their own leak
svg.desc: An animated board from the POISONKEY app. BOB and CARA each have 50 XLM bonded. A copy of BOB's secret key leaks into the leak hunter field; ALICE signs grant_id || her address with it, ed25519_verify passes, BOB's bond bar drains to zero and his status flips from BONDED to BURNED, then 25 XLM goes to ALICE and 25 XLM to the owner. CARA stays bonded.
